There will, of course, be a reward for you.” The hunters looked at each other, looking at their battered equipment and grime-covered clothing. “How much are we talking?”, Sirenn inquired. Nox, for sure, had not seen this coming. If someone would have told him only a week ago, he would be fighting some captured beasts for the amusement of some well-paying individuals, he would have laughed in that person's face. But there he was, summoning his quite worn rifle to his side, which was quickly swallowed by the shadows that made up his right arm, preparing to walk out into a fighting rink right in Paterna Iter's centre. He fixed up his armour, strapping it tighter to himself as to not give the creature waiting for him any chance at tearing it apart. Then he looked over towards Sirenn, whom he would fight together with after this first fight. The Scourgeborne nodded at him encouragingly.
“Just see it as if it were another hunt”, he told him. “Only this time it's actually for the money”, Nox sighed. “With which we can return with better equipped to fight for what we believe in.”

backstory.title: Chapter XIII — Cat and Mouse
paragraphs: Amongst the other Hunters Nox did not stand out. His grey robes did not catch anyone’s eye and the crest on his chest marked him simply as one of many. They were tracking down a creature that was driven by the Scourge to attack their camp many a times. Kadar had warned them of following the beast into the Ruby District but with a Veteran Jaegar on their side, they were relatively confident. There was barely a soul to be seen out in this eternal night, the people were too frightened of the Scourge, only leaving their hastily reinforced shelter when they had no choice. Thus the group was easily able to follow the beast without disturbance. The Shadow Rogue was traversing the rooftops masterfully, keeping an eye out for trouble and trying to spot the creature in the dim light. They were getting ever closer to the outer wall of the former city. It was a giant monument built of stone and steel to keep out threats. And now keep them in.

Their prey had already made its way into the District, when the Hunters reached the underground pathway. Malik circled high above their heads, scouring the ground with his ever-perceptive eye. Only when the group's leader, a Scourgeborne Jaegar, who had been hunting tirelessly for many years now, heaved up the metal trapdoor and urged them forward, did the owl dive downwards to return to his master. Nox vanished into a shadow next to him, emerging from the one closest to the others, before dropping down into the chasm. Sirenn followed, his antlers scraping the makeshift ceiling of the underground pathway. After a moment, a lantern illuminated the dirt-and-stone walls.

The four of them reached the other trapdoor, leading up to an old watchtower of the Ruby District, that had been abandoned for a long time now, a fact that saved the underground-way from being closed off like the ones under the other watchtowers. As Sirenn extinguished the lantern, Nox used his umbral form to quickly get up, offering a hand to the other hunters. Malik had taken off towards the top of the tower. “Alright, plan is simple. Kill the thing, retreat. Don't attract their attention, else these things might figure out where we came from and where we'll be heading. Got it?” The other hunters nodded in affirmation, momentarily ascending the watchtower, dodging broken and breaking steps. Reaching the top, they scouted the area and made their way onto the rooftop next to them. They make their way further into the Ruby District. The streets were filled with the Scourged, snarling, roaring, biting at each other. The dark swallowed the hunters as they tracked their prey, preparing their strike when they spotted it. Nox took aim at the creature, while Sirenn made his way down towards the it. He charged at it, knocking it into the wall and locking it in place, Hessia's magic slowed the creature's movement and Jalan guided each of their allies, making Nox' shot hit dead centre, killing the creature with a single shot. The group withdrew, returning to the rooftops and using the veil of night to rush back to the watchtower.

Another successful hunt. Now this mission turned from a chase to an escape from the most dangerous District, ever since the invasion started. Suddenly, right before they reached the relative safety of the watchtower, Malik dove down towards them, the familiar clearly warning them of incoming danger. All four of the hunters were immediately alarmed, checking their surroundings for the imminent threat. Only when Malik landed on Nox' arm, panicked gaze shifting up again and again, did the Shadow Rogue realise the direction the creature was coming from. He barely managed to dodge out of the way of the swoop from above. And when the tall beast landed in front of him, he had already vanished into the shadows and Malik was quickly dismissed. Hessia and Jalan started casting but the beast was faster, it jumped the younger wizard, knocking him to the ground. Sirenn readied his cleaver, running at the flying beast and knocking it down. Nox reappeared several feat away and took aim. Though with Sirenn and Jalan right there, he awaited a cleared line of sight. The young wizard scurried away, holding his arm, that had clearly received a sharp blow. Despite the pain, he finished casting the Silence spell on the beast, that instantly started flailing around, seemingly blinded. It managed to hit Sirenn square in the chest, knocking him back slightly. Hessia pointed at the ground next to it and a giant spiderweb sprung into existence, entangling the bat-like beast. They withdrew once again, rushing towards the watchtower once more, reaching it, right as a deafening screech rung through the air.

Several Scourged had taken notice of the fighting, one of them was still scouring over the giant bat, tearing it apart, while another one tried to gain some scraps out of it. There were at least a dozen beasts, waiting to tear apart the hunters that had dared enter their home. If Sirenn's face was anything to go by, they were severely outmatched. And even if they were to escape through the tunnel in time, they would lead the Scourged directly into their camp. They quickly dropped down into an alleyway and Sirenn ripped open a sewer's plate for them to drop down into the pure dark. “We are done for!”, Jalan's voice sounded in their heads. Sirenn in turn shook his, “We'll find a way out. We just need a plan.” “Invisibility?”, Hessia suggested, “Jalan, are you feeling up for that?”

The wizard hugged himself tightly but before he he could answer, Sirenn shook his head, “Most of them don't rely on their eyes alone. They would notice us anyway.” “Is there a way through the sewers maybe?”, Hessia asked, fiddling with her militia-emblem. “Not that I know of”, Sirenn looked down the dark corridor with its swirling waters and unforeseeable dangers. “You won't like it-”, Nox started up. Sirenn's eyes found his despite the darkness. “But I could lead them away. Distract them long enough for you to get away and close the tunnel.” “Close it?”, the Scourgeborne repeated, “You mean shut down our only way back into the city, once this is over?” “Once this is over. We will find another way. Right now our priority should be to keep the civilians safe, right? If this means not having a way in now, then so be it”, the Shadow remained stationary, looking up at Sirenn, who had gotten up. A moment of silence fell between them, though outside of their group, nobody could hear their words anyway. Finally Sirenn seemed to make a decision, placing a hand on Nox' shoulder. “What is the plan then. How will you get out?”

Nox looked down at the giant clawed hand on his shoulder, before giving the Jaegar a small confident smile. “I am part of the Order, remember? I'll get over the wall.” Malik shot up into the sky, screeching and attracting the attention of the Scourged all around him, which jumped to follow the bird. The three remaining hunters waited, as Nox climbed up and followed Malik while shadowed. Then they swarmed up, silently making their way back towards the tunnel. Nox felt a jolt running through his right arm, the shadows twisting harder around what was left of his shoulder, as Malik took a claw to the wing and vanished. He appeared from the shadows and called out, at the beasts that turned tail to rush back towards the tower. They locked onto their new target, who jumped into the streets below, as they laid in complete darkness in which he could vanish whenever he needed to. Soon his lungs burned, his breath coming in short heaves, as the air whipped around his head and almost knocked him over. He had been running for what felt like hours although he was aware that it had been only nine minutes and forty-two seconds. Forty-three. Forty-Four.

He did not know the layout of the Ruby District well enough to navigate it effortlessly. Many buildings were torn to the ground, smashed to pieces or inhabited by the creatures that had destroyed the rest of them. A sad sight but nothing to dwell on for too long. Something grasped at him from above, forcing him to dodge the grapple by diving down and rolling. Nox sprung back to his feet, right before one of the Scourged behind him could catch up. He knew it would take the others around six minutes through the tunnels, though he had no guess how long it might take them to close it up. The other tunnels had been closed by a small group of mages. However it might happen now, Nox hoped it would be fast. He did not know how much longer he could keep up in this game of cat and mouse. After another few minutes, he had been running for over thirteen minutes now, he finally saw a light fire a fair way away. They had actually sent someone far enough away from the settlement to safely light a signal for him. He knew because they were the only ones using this colour of fire. He turned heel, dashing towards the high wall, vanishing back into the shadows, as the creatures behind him quickly lost his trail, left once more to fight and bite at each other. When Nox finally reached the top of the wall, he stopped. He had never seen so much of the lands surrounding Luyarnha. The sight was breathtaking. Maybe one day he could see all of it up close. He could travel these lands. Once everyone was free. Once this threat was dealt with. Then he could be free too.

npcs.name: Eunoia Sonderliv
npcs.description: Shadar Kai, Paladin, member of the House of Blood, formerly Blood Cross a strict woman and mother of four, she is prideful but honest, very set in her beliefs and would do anything for the radiant church, her name as well as her methods of torture are known to all within the Church

npcs.name: Candor Sonderliv
npcs.description: a caring man with unyielding belief in good, despite not being Solan's and Nox' actual father, he cared for them more than their mother did, he turned away from Eunoia around four years ago

npcs.name: Zenathin Fireil
npcs.description: Shadar Kai, Rogue (Radiant Blade), member of the Grey Templars a closed off and secretive individual with a former blind devotion to the Radiant Church and its goals, after the birth of his sons, he was refused all opportunity to meet them, causing him to start doubting the Church's ways, he turned against them, working with different groups and giving out information to them, when he found out Nox was planning to kill him, he waited for the opportunity to explain himself to his son, but as he was doing so, they both were surprised by two fighters of the Church, that had caught wind of his doings, he died protecting his son

npcs.name: Narech Sonderliv
npcs.description: Half-Elf, Ranger (Torturer Conclave), member of the House of Blood the oldest of the brothers, with a sick and uncaring demeanour, who enjoys hurting others a little bit too much, he was taught by his mother, in turn he does not have a good relationship with his father

npcs.name: Genjor Sonderliv
npcs.description: Half-Elf, Wizard, member of the Obitus Scholare the second oldest, with a mind sharper than a knife and a faith greater than most, he is one of the leading minds among the Obitus Scholare, his desire for reinvention and discovery tends to be greater than his worry about the consequences

npcs.name: Solan Sonderliv
npcs.description: Nox' twin, Solan was the vocal one of the two, always up for a joke and beloved by most of their age, though just like with Nox his mother was unloving of him, Solan died from the Mycophagic Pestilence when he was thirteen

npcs.name: Igni Sonderliv
npcs.description: Half Elf, Fighter (Living Nightmare), member of the Militia the youngest sibling and only daughter of the family, she turned out to be a more than capable fighter, quickly able to dispose of any threat quickly and effectively, she is very ambitious, was one of the only fighters of the Militia that agreed to the Obitus Scholare's experiments

npcs.name: Sirenn
npcs.description: former Elf, now Scourgeborne (Cervus), Jaegar, Hunter and ally of the Militia a brave, loyal Jaegar, who has been in business for many years now and has risked his life many-a-times for the safety of the people around him

npcs.name: Jalan Valeheart
npcs.description: Human, Wizard, Hunter and ally of the Militia a young wizard who laid down his life protecting his friends and the settlement outside the walls, despite his fears and shortcomings in battle in the end he turned out braver than many other Hunters

npcs.name: Hessia
npcs.description: Accursed Tiefling, Warlock, member of the Militia a talented warlock with a great disdain for cowardice, she strictly believes in the rule of might and thus has great respect for her allies, who each have proven themselves to her in various ways

npcs.name: Kadar Hartrent
npcs.description: former Elf, now Scourgeborne (Aranea), Shadow Rogue, member of the Shadow Order also known as 7, he is one of the initial Order, and now keeper of the Tome of Shadow, if he were to die, the Tome teleports to the next in line, in this case, Nox, he is a calm and calculated man, who knows everything about planning and strategizing and has great intel on the most different of subjects

npcs.name: Vassia Stedfort
npcs.description: Half-Elf, Noble a smart and kind woman, who used her wealth and influence to care for the people of Luyarnha, paying many doctors that would normally not treat the common-folk and giving as much as she could to the orphanages all around the city, she has an immense talent and a great love for chess and works with Kadar to guide and help out Hunters
